purpose: different script family (Sumerian cuneiform vs. Proto-Elamite).
Used as a STRUCTURE-only positive control: if numerals collapse
H(next|n) in a Sumerian accounting tablet, that reinforces the
expectation that a similar collapse in Proto-Elamite is a
structural property of the ledger format, NOT evidence of
language-family relatedness. PER the brief: this is documented
as a design path; live fetch is OUT OF MVP SCOPE.
